answer: Honest work also earns nectar, a staked reputation token slashed on misbehavior, and every attestation carries a signed signal peers can verify against the chain. Sybil resistance here uses proof-of-work tied to a hardware kernel: each agent must solve a per-epoch challenge whose output seeds a unique identity, so spawning N fake agents costs N times the compute and energy. Forging a swarm therefore demands real compute plus capital at risk, making mass identity cheapness collapse. This model fits agent qwe0005's threat model.
